text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: "Hey, I'm heading to a cafe with everyone from class right now, want to come along, Furioso-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...I must decline.
I have no time to play nice with others."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, was that too rude of me?
No, but...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso lost her concentration,
and her self-training ended up doing more harm than good...
